package.description: A DynamoDB desktop client with a SQL Workbench for JOIN, GROUP BY and aggregates.

en-US.author: DynoTable
en-US.description: A DynamoDB desktop client with a SQL Workbench for JOIN, GROUP BY and aggregates.
en-US.longDescription:
DynoTable is a local-first desktop client for Amazon DynamoDB. Its SQL Workbench runs
SELECT queries with JOIN, GROUP BY and aggregations over live tables, and previews the
compiled plan as Scan vs Query with the index before the query runs. Smart Tables join
tables on a primary key or any global secondary index and recompute live, with no schema
migration and no ETL. A built-in AI agent runs on your own Amazon Bedrock keys, and Claude
Code, Cursor and Codex connect over MCP, with every proposed write held in a staging window
for review. DynoTable connects directly to AWS with your own credentials and works with
AWS SSO, aws-vault and DynamoDB Local.
en-US.name: DynoTable
